name: LS-BLOC Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: This product uses an all-welded plate pack with a hexahedron detachable structure so that the equipment can meet mechanical and chemical cleaning requirements. According to the official product page, it retains the high heat transfer efficiency and compact structure of a traditional plate heat exchanger while allowing use under higher pressure and temperature conditions in petroleum, chemical, electric power, pharmaceutical, metallurgy, and refrigeration service.
advantage: Hexahedron detachable structure supports mechanical and chemical cleaning inside the equipment.
Keeps the high heat transfer efficiency and compact structure of a plate heat exchanger.
Suitable for higher pressure and temperature conditions than conventional detachable plate equipment.

seo_data.meta_description: Hexahedron removable all-welded plate exchanger for high-pressure and high-temperature process duty.
